title: UFOs Past, Present and Future and the Holloman AFB contact
place_text: Holloman Air Force Base, New Mexico

tellings.quote: contact look they're saying contact yeah with acted military at Hallman Air Force Base in 1972 or 74

related.note: It is the same Serling film, UFOs: Past, Present, and Future, and the same claim that a military base offered UFO footage, but this telling names Edwards AFB, where the story names Holloman AFB.

plain: The makers of the documentary UFOs Past, Present and Future, Robert Emenegger and Allan Sandler, with Rod Serling involved, are said to have been told of contact between aliens and the military at Holloman Air Force Base in New Mexico, in 1972 or 1974. The UFO investigator James Fox tells this as a summary of the film's background, without naming who told the filmmakers. If true, it would mean the military itself pointed filmmakers toward a contact event.
